protocol.split: grouped corpus split (StratifiedGroupKFold, 10 folds, seed 0; fold 0 test, fold 1 val)
protocol.index: FAISS IndexFlatIP over grouped train+val questions
protocol.fusion: alpha=0.4 (dense) + 0.6 (word TF-IDF), same as deployed weight
protocol.relevance: retrieved weak keyword label == test weak keyword label (topical proxy, not correctness)

original_split_reference.note: The original near-duplicate share is expected to fall to ~0 under the grouped split.

limitations: Relevance is a weak-label topical proxy, not human relevance or agronomic correctness.
Only one grouped split seed was run for retrieval because the index rebuild is expensive.
The hybrid evaluation uses a fixed 3,000-query sample; dense metrics use all grouped test rows.
Token-F1 is still single-reference; multi-reference evaluation is Batch B.
The corpus metadata has no district/date field, so temporal or district-held-out evaluation is not possible.
